sections.details: Updated guidelines on the prevention of infective endocarditis.
Various studies discuss the under-recognition of 22q11.2 deletion syndromes and its effects on patients with congenital heart defects.
Discusses the spectrum and outcomes of congenital heart diseases in Europe during the follow-up period of the Euro Heart Survey.
Explores issues related to hepatitis C infection and noncardiac surgery in adults with congenital heart defects.
Reviews factors influencing perioperative events and outcomes for adults with congenital heart disease undergoing noncardiac surgery.
Examines cardiac outcomes during pregnancy in women with congenital heart disease and the implications of reproductive healthcare.

genes.context: The guideline discusses the under-recognition of 22q11.2 deletion syndrome and its association with congenital heart defects, referencing multiple studies highlighting its prevalence and diagnostic challenges.
